{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print("Sample of revenue values:", df['revenue'].head())

# Check for invalid revenue values (e.g., 999999.99)
print("Rows with revenue == 999999.99:", df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check status and segment for LOYAL customers
print("Total LOYAL customers with completed status:", df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')].shape[0])

# Check if there are any refunded LOYAL orders
print("LOYAL customers with refunded status:", df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'refunded')].shape[0])"}
